title: North Yorkshire Council: Using AI to reimagine Children’s Social Care
summary: North Yorkshire Council reports that its Microsoft Azure AI proof of concept for children's social-care records cut the time and cost of some data-retrieval tasks by 90% in testing.
account: North Yorkshire Council developed a Microsoft Azure AI proof of concept for semantic search and relationship maps in children's social-care records held in the Liquidlogic case-management system. In testing, some data-retrieval tasks reportedly required 90% less time and cost than in the current system. The Local Government Association account states that the Department for Education fund for the pilot ended on 31 March 2024. At a webinar on 3 July 2025, the council's head of data and insight still described the tool as the Children's Social Care Knowledge Mining Prototype. Global Government Forum reported on 16 July 2025 that the prototype scans documents related to a case and produces a diagram of the child's connections. Operational adoption and improved safeguarding outcomes remain unverified.
purpose: Improve retrieval and interpretation of children’s social-care records, including relationships among people and cases.
system: Microsoft Azure AI proof of concept for semantic search and automatically generated eco-maps in Liquidlogic LCS records
developer: North Yorkshire Council using Microsoft Azure AI

The sources report a task-level test result for the council and no outcome for any social worker, child or family. Improved child safety is not established.
